biggest_catch: Election Day runs from 6am until tabulation is complete after polls close at 8pm (14+ hours) for $195-$250.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is ~14+ hours (6am until tabulation completes after 8pm close).
Pay varies by position ($195-$250), not a single flat rate.
Mandatory poll worker training before serving.
Must be a registered voter of Luzerne County and 18+.

c1.evidence: Luzerne County PA official site (luzernecounty.org), Election Day Poll Workers page.

c2.evidence: '$195 to $250 (tax free)' for the day, depending on position.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: Registered voter of Luzerne County; 18 years or older; mandatory poll worker training before serving.
notes: Election Day Roving Technician has a separate application path.
numeric_basis: payout: official $195-$250/day by position; time: official 6am arrival to past 8pm close with tabulation (840 min + est 60-120 min tabulation) + mandatory training (duration unstated, est 120-180 min)
payout_quote: Depending on the position you hold at the polling place, your compensation for the day will range between $195 to $250 (tax free)

steps: Complete and submit the Poll Worker Interest Form on the county page.
Sign up for and attend mandatory poll worker training.
Serve Election Day: arrive 6am for setup, stay until tabulation is complete after the 8pm close.
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; training held periodically throughout the year.
